note: Japanese large numbers group in units of 10,000 (万), not 1,000. Ten thousand is 一万, one hundred thousand is 十万, and one million is 百万 (100 × 10,000). Build the 万 part, then the thousands, hundreds, tens and units. Say ひゃく and usually せん without いち. In the examples, 円（えん）means yen.
